CustomField.formula: IF(ISNULL( PF_Date_Completed__c ), TODAY() - DATEVALUE (CreatedDate), PF_Date_Completed__c - DATEVALUE (CreatedDate))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is the number of days the work task has aged since created. If the defect is still open, then it calculates from Today - Created Date. If the work task is completed, then it calculates from Date Completed - Created Date.
CustomField.label: Age (In Days)
